g.text: okanetsolutions/briareus · 4 open pull requests · synced 2 min ago
Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.

The tree is servers, then databases (SHOW DATABASES), then tables, in a 300px column, or a third of the width if smaller, that scrolls on its own. The grid shows the first 200 rows ('The first 200 rows'), numbered, with NULL in muted
text; queries run over SSH on the server's mysql client.
The Database tab has no header picker of its own, and the code does not set a subtitle for it. I assume the header keeps the generic project line; I did not confirm this.

Tree notes: 'Connecting…', 'No databases.', 'Loading tables…', 'No tables.', and 'No database login is stored for this server. Add one to it under ⚙ Settings → SSH servers.' The empty grid says 'No table selected — Click a
server on the left to see its databases…'.
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
